café.en: We met at a quiet café near the station after class.
café.zh: 下課後，我們在車站附近一間安靜的咖啡館見面。

blaze.en: The news report described a blaze that firefighters quickly brought under control.
blaze.zh: 新聞報導描述了一場迅速被消防人員控制住的大火。

coffin.en: The museum displayed an ancient coffin as part of its history exhibition.
coffin.zh: 博物館在歷史展覽中展示了一具古代棺木。

riot.en: The history class examined how a riot affected the city's public life.
riot.zh: 歷史課探討了一場暴動如何影響城市的公共生活。

slave.en: The textbook explains how a slave was denied basic freedom in many past societies.
slave.zh: 課本說明在許多過去的社會中，奴隸被剝奪基本自由。

slavery.en: The class studied slavery as an important issue in modern world history.
slavery.zh: 全班把奴隸制度作為近代世界史的重要議題來學習。

sober.en: The article uses a sober tone when discussing the serious economic problem.
sober.zh: 這篇文章以嚴肅冷靜的語氣討論這項重要的經濟問題。

starvation.en: The documentary explains how crop failure can increase the risk of starvation.
starvation.zh: 這部紀錄片說明農作物歉收如何提高飢荒的風險。

starve.en: Wild animals may starve when their natural food sources disappear for long periods.
starve.zh: 當天然食物來源長期消失時，野生動物可能會挨餓。

toxic.en: The science lesson explains why toxic materials require careful professional handling.
toxic.zh: 自然科課程說明為何有毒物質需要由專業人員謹慎處理。

underwear.en: The travel checklist reminds students to pack enough underwear for the entire trip.
underwear.zh: 旅行清單提醒學生為整趟旅程準備足夠的內衣褲。

battlefield.en: The historian used old maps to explain changes around the battlefield.
battlefield.zh: 歷史學家利用舊地圖說明戰場周邊的變化。

besiege.en: The history text describes how armies would besiege fortified cities in earlier centuries.
besiege.zh: 歷史課文描述早期幾個世紀軍隊如何圍困設防的城市。

brigade.en: The museum exhibit explains the role of a brigade in military organization.
brigade.zh: 博物館展覽說明旅級單位在軍事組織中的角色。

brutality.en: The documentary discusses the brutality of war without showing graphic images.
brutality.zh: 這部紀錄片討論戰爭的殘酷性，但沒有呈現血腥畫面。

childbirth.en: The health textbook introduces childbirth as part of basic human biology.
childbirth.zh: 健康課本把分娩作為基礎人體生物學的一部分來介紹。

color-blind.en: The design team tested whether the chart remained clear for color-blind readers.
color-blind.zh: 設計團隊測試圖表對色盲讀者而言是否仍然清楚。

counterattack.en: The history lesson mentioned a counterattack while explaining the course of the battle.
counterattack.zh: 歷史課在說明戰役進程時提到了一次反攻。

militant.en: The article uses militant as a historical term in its discussion of political movements.
militant.zh: 這篇文章在討論政治運動時，把 militant 當作歷史用語使用。

warship.en: The maritime museum displays a model warship from an earlier period of history.
warship.zh: 海事博物館展示了一艘早期歷史時期軍艦的模型。
